description: OpenLEADR is the LF Energy project's Python implementation of client and server interfaces for OpenADR 2.0b demand response. Its VEN client and VTN server exchange registration messages, telemetry reports and events over secured, signed HTTP-pull connections. Inputs are configured event and reporting handlers; outputs are demand-response messages and received measurements. Geographic coverage and event timing follow the connected systems, with no supplied national load series. Source is free under Apache-2.0, and the project publishes client/server examples and a test suite. A limitation is incomplete protocol coverage: HTTP push, XMPP, status reports, history reports and EiOpt are listed as unimplemented. The maintainers also describe the code as developmental. OpenLEADR can connect controllers in grid and flexible-load simulation experiments. Vessim (platform-vessim) is a related energy-management simulator. No live utility endpoint or control system was contacted.
